verdict.rationale: Power efficiency and battery life are a fair axis for a laptop processor, so the story applies. The evidence pack shows no fanless or low-power designs and no battery-life data. AMD's own spec lists a configurable TDP of 45-120W, which points to actively cooled, higher-power machines rather than the thin, quiet, all-day-battery designs the story asks for.

support.subject: As a power-user, this chip powers thin, quiet, all-day-battery machines — shipping in fanless or low-power designs with credible battery-life evidence
